evidence: Animal aortas: 549 shared DEGs; 155 shared pathways; matrix and smooth-muscle programmes
interpretation: Broad molecular convergence in experimental models

evidence: Two of six frozen programmes recurred in both datasets: extracellular matrix organization and ossification
interpretation: Narrower, non-directional human support; one dataset confounds disease with arterial site

evidence: No primary MR estimate passed BH correction; LDSC non-estimable; colocalization prior-sensitive; reverse MR limited
interpretation: Does not establish a renal-to-dissection relationship; smaller effects remain possible

evidence: No immune programme passed correction in either human dataset; random-gene controls performed similarly; external AUCs varied
interpretation: Does not establish immune replication, renal-origin specificity or future-risk prediction

evidence: A bounded arterial-remodelling tissue-state overlap, strongest for matrix-related programmes
interpretation: Not a causal mechanism, therapeutic target or generalizable renal-derived signature
